disposition_reason: Table 2 prints mean ± SD and ranges of seven metals in field-grown coriander, onion and tomato (and soil) near a highway in Jhansi, dry weight.

study.design: Field survey of soil and vegetables near a national highway with bio-concentration and health risk
study.origin: Farmers' fields at seven sites near NH-27, Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, India
study.period_text: spring and summer seasons (year not stated)
study.method: HClO4/HNO3 (1:3) wet digestion; flame AAS (Perkin-Elmer AAnalyst 400)
study.lod_text: IDL said to be below MDL and MQL; values not printed
study.qa: Calibration curves, frequent blanks; no CRM or recovery reported
